style.name: Sapphire Geometry
style.blend: Contemporary Art Deco + Quiet Luxury Contemporary
style.definition: Sapphire upholstery and precise geometry create a cool, polished room with warm edges.

style.living: sapphire channel 210cm sofa; warm-gray wool chair; oval smoked-glass coffee table on brass legs; walnut media cabinet; 105cm walnut round dining table and four blue-gray chairs; ribbed-glass pendant
style.bed: sapphire channel queen headboard; walnut nightstands; brass opal lamps; gray-blue throw
style.solarium: dark teak frames and blue outdoor cushions; teak dining set
style.implement: Repeat a restrained stepped motif in the rug and mirror, keeping most walls ivory.
style.avoid: Avoid blue accent lighting and glossy blue cabinetry.
